'''Tret''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Tret accompanied a number of tourists that were visiting the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] production plants on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uffel]], in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. During the trip, Tret and some of the other tourists, the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Nia Reston]], [[San Herrera]], and [[Philinda]], and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Nikolo]], were recruited by the droid [[LN-73]] into assisting him at sabotaging the production facilities. LN-73 accomplished this by lying to them by claiming that [[HG-211]], Uffel's head of security, had been corrupted. Tret and the rest of the group then attacked the [[Heroes of Cularin]], who LN-73 falsely claimed were sabotaging the droid factories.
